# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

98 tools in 22 groups, plus 5 meta-tools (`search_tools`, `describe_tool`, `call_tool`, `batch`, `jobs`).

**Listed** tools appear in `tools/list` on the default surface; the rest are reached with `search_tools` and `call_tool` (or listed directly with `ZENDRIVER_MCP_SURFACE=full`). **Effect** is what the annotations declare: `read` changes nothing, `write` changes page or browser state, `destructive` discards state. Tools marked **tab** also take an optional `tab` argument (`?` marks an optional parameter).

## Browser lifecycle

| Tool | Effect | Tab | Listed | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_browser_status` | read |  | yes | none | Check whether the browser is running, and list its open tabs. |
| `start_browser` | write |  | yes | `headless?`, `proxy?`, `user_data_dir?`, `low_memory?`, `window_size?`, `device_scale_factor?` | Launch the browser and start a session. Required before every other tool. |
| `stop_browser` | destructive |  | yes | none | Stop the browser, close every tab, and release all session resources. |

## Navigation

| Tool | Effect | Tab | Listed | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_page_info` | read | tab |  | none | Get the active tab's current URL and title. |
| `go_back` | write | tab |  | none | Go back one entry in the active tab's history, as the browser back button does. |
| `go_forward` | write | tab |  | none | Go forward one entry in the active tab's history, as the browser forward button does. |
| `navigate` | write | tab | yes | `url`, `settle?` | Navigate the active tab to a URL, then wait for it to finish rendering. |
| `reload_page` | write | tab |  | none | Reload the active tab at its current URL. |

## Tabs

| Tool | Effect | Tab | Listed | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `close_tab` | destructive |  |  | `tab_id` | Close one tab by id, leaving the browser and other tabs running. |
| `list_tabs` | read |  | yes | none | List every open tab with its id and current URL. |
| `new_tab` | write |  |  | `url?` | Open a new browser tab and make it the active tab. |
| `switch_tab` | write |  |  | `tab_id` | Make an existing tab the active one, so later tools act on it. |

## Page content

| Tool | Effect | Tab | Listed | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_content` | read | tab |  | `max_chars?`, `offset?` | Get the page's full rendered HTML, including markup and attributes. |
| `get_interaction_tree` | read | tab | yes | `limit?`, `links?` | List the page's interactive elements, each with a short numeric id. |
| `get_text_content` | read | tab | yes | `max_chars?`, `offset?` | Get the page's visible text, without any HTML markup. |
| `scroll` | write | tab | yes | `direction?`, `amount?` | Scroll the page vertically by a pixel amount. |
| `scroll_to_element` | write | tab |  | `selector` | Scroll the page until one element is centred in the viewport. |

## Elements

| `clear_input` | write | tab |  | `selector` | Empty an input, textarea, or contenteditable element. |

## Cookies and storage (per page)

| Tool | Effect | Tab | Listed | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clear_storage` | destructive | tab |  | none | Clear both localStorage and sessionStorage for the current origin. |
| `get_cookies` | read | tab |  | none | Read the cookies that apply to the current page, HttpOnly ones included. |
| `get_local_storage` | read | tab |  | none | Read every localStorage key and value for the current page's origin. |
| `set_cookie` | write | tab |  | `name`, `value`, `domain?`, `path?`, `expires?`, `secure?`, `http_only?`, `same_site?` | Set one cookie for the current page's site, through CDP. |
| `set_local_storage` | write | tab |  | `key`, `value` | Write one localStorage item for the current page's origin. |

## Cookie jar (whole browser)

| Tool | Effect | Tab | Listed | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clear_all_cookies` | destructive |  |  | none | Delete every cookie in the browser, for every site. |
| `export_cookies` | destructive |  |  | `file_path?` | Save every cookie, HttpOnly included, to a JSON file for import_cookies. |
| `import_cookies` | write |  |  | `file_path` | Load cookies from a JSON file produced by export_cookies. |
| `list_all_cookies` | read |  |  | none | Return every cookie the browser is holding, across all sites. |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clear_logs` | destructive |  |  | none | Discard all captured network and console logs, for every tab. |

| Tool | Effect | Tab | Listed | Parameters | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `block_urls` | write | tab |  | `patterns` | Block this tab's future requests whose URL matches any pattern. |
| `bypass_service_worker` | write | tab |  | `bypass?` | Make this tab skip its service worker and always go to the network. |
